sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

items: Check the back up software for the cabinet.

Check the operation of net work card function 
 (data highway controller card (MHC card) by using (system highway errors) 
 diagram.
Clean all cabinet cards from dust by blower.

Check the cabinet status by using (system 
 status display) diagram.

Check the multibus power supply of primary 
 controller (+ 12V DC , 5V DC) .

Check the transmitter power supply (24V DC) 
 status by leds on the front of P.S.

Check Q-line power supply (13V DC) status by 
 using system status display diagram.
Check the operation of cabinet cooling fan.

Check the multibus power supply of Secondary 
 controller (+12V DC , 5V DC) .

Check both of primary and backup Controller 
 data base by using configuration diagram on the operator station.

Introduction
This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, which must performed on an annually bases as indicted by 
Y1 in the title block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Mohamed Abu Elkheir, reviewed by eng. Aly Abd Elglil Abd Elqader, tested by eng.
Mohamed Younes at 10 Jan 2005, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abd 
Elmenem Alemam, accepted by general director eng. Adel Alkelany, and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Hamouda Elsarage Head Sector of Damietta CCPS.
This document is certified by eng. Samir 
 Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant; 
 Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Soliman;
 EDEPC admin and financial inspection, quality control General Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.

Check the multibus power supply of primary 
 controller (+ 12V DC , 5V DC) .
Check the transmitter power supply (24V DC) 
 status by leds on the front of P.S.
Check Q-line power supply (13V DC) status by 
 using system status display diagram.
Check the operation of cabinet cooling fan.
Check the multibus power supply of Secondary 
 controller (+12V DC , 5V DC) .
Check both of primary and backup Controller 
 data base by using configuration diagram on the operator station.
